title: IngestMonitoringEvent
description: Event emitted by this ingest fragment to report its data ingestion status to data-ingest-monitor.

source.description: Identifier of the ingest fragment publishing the event.

source_name.description: Human-readable instance name set by the orchestrator from digital_twin_fragment.name. Optional — older publishers may omit it.

records_processed.description: Number of records processed in the last ingest cycle.
